## Outcome

Describe the user or system behavior this PR changes.

## Scope

Describe the implementation and important non-goals.

## Validation

List commands and environments that actually ran. State anything that could not run.

- [ ] Static/build checks
- [ ] Unit or host tests
- [ ] Integration tests
- [ ] Simulation
- [ ] Physical HIL
- [ ] Manual verification

## Risk and rollback

Describe security/privacy/data/hardware risk, compatibility impact, rollout, and how
to revert or disable the change.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Referenced paths and dependencies exist.
- [ ] Failures are not masked or ignored.
- [ ] Product requirements are separated from benchmark hypotheses.
- [ ] Tests cover the relevant failure behavior.
- [ ] Logs, fixtures, and issue text contain no secrets.
- [ ] Documentation and linked issues match the implementation.
